top: subsidy per tonne of DAP in kharif 2026, up 18% on kharif 2025.
a tonne is the shortfall on imported DAP at May's price, after retail price and subsidy.
a tonne is the import price the kharif 2026 subsidy can carry; India paid $930–935.

sections.h2: The DAP subsidy rose each season, to Rs 32,787 a tonne in kharif 2026

chart.title: The DAP subsidy has risen each season, reaching Rs 32,787 a tonne
chart.sub: Nutrient-based subsidy on one tonne of DAP 18-46-0, Rs.
chart.source: Union Cabinet approval, April 2026; NBS rates.

sections.means: DAP's subsidy rose from Rs 27,800 a tonne in kharif 2025 to Rs 32,787 in kharif 2026, as the per-kilogram rates for phosphate and nitrogen went up.
sections.todo: Revise the kharif rates, as the Fertiliser Association of India has asked, given raw-material prices up 100–200% after the West Asia conflict.

sections.h2: Imported DAP earns less than it costs, a shortfall of Rs 29,733 a tonne

chart.title: The shortfall on imported DAP is more than five times its rabi 2025-26 level
chart.sub: Import cost less farmer price and subsidy, Rs per tonne, before handling costs.
chart.source: IPL tender, May 2026; NBS rates; this blog's arithmetic.

sections.means: In kharif 2026 the farmer's Rs 27,000 plus the Rs 32,787 subsidy is Rs 59,787 against an import cost of about Rs 89,520 a tonne.
sections.todo: Publish who bears the shortfall, since it is not published and otherwise shows up only later in company results, supplementary subsidies or supply.

sections.h2: The subsidy covers imported DAP only up to about $623 a tonne

chart.title: The break-even import price has stayed between $623 and $640 a tonne
chart.sub: Import price that retail price plus subsidy would cover, $ per tonne.
chart.source: This blog's arithmetic on DAP CFR prices.

sections.means: The market moved from about $700 to more than $930 while the break-even price stayed between $623 and $640, so the gap widened.
sections.todo: Set the kharif rates against the import price, not only against last season's rates, so that the subsidy tracks what importers pay.

sections.h2: Kharif 2026 alone commits 77% of the year's NBS subsidy budget

chart.title: Kharif 2026 commits Rs 41,534 crore, 12% more than a year earlier

sections.means: The provisional 2026-27 NBS allocation was about Rs 54,000 crore, and the kharif season alone has committed about 77% of it.
sections.todo: Expect a mid-year revision of the allocation, as 2025-26 was raised 22.5% above its provisional figure.
